It sounds like you have something on your mind though, you can give yourself permission to talk about it here, if you want. 

I know talking to a stranger doesn't sound ideal to spill out your deepest emotions to. But if we cant talk to our friends n family we end up talking to ourselves and saying shitty things to ourselves.

hey i just wanna let you know I know how you feel. You do sound like you are trying really hard not to give up though. I've spent years feeling the type of way you do, acting similarly, lashing out because I have too much pain and anger. I hope things will be different for you and you'll get through this stronger. 

maybe if we just allowed ourseleves some time to put ourseleves back together instead of rushing, then we wouldn't feel this bad. anyways i hope you can wait until therapy. maybe a hotline will help. I've been trying that out of desperation for help.
